veio.guide.page.02:
First factory

Your goal is one gear.
Extract copper, press plates and assemble parts.

Follow one page at a time. Later pages are a reference.
veio.guide.page.03:
Gather the parts

6 copper ingots
3 iron ingots
3 pistons
1 spare crafting table
1 furnace
1 smooth stone
3 sticks
1 chest and coal

These are finished parts.
veio.guide.page.04:
How to craft

Use a crafting table. Veio recipes accept ingredients in any arrangement.

The green recipe book lists unlocked recipes.
Reference pages list ingredients.
veio.guide.page.05:
1. Prepare power

Craft a generator and wooden poles. Open the generator and add coal or wood.

Place a pole within 2 blocks of the generator and machines. Poles wire themselves together.
veio.guide.page.06:
2. Find a vein

Find copper ore in the world. Put the extractor directly ON TOP of it.

Touch it with a powered cable.

The panel should show activity.
veio.guide.page.07:
3. Build the line

Extractor > belt > press > chest

Place all endpoints at the same height. Face the destination when placing blocks.

The port is the output. Branch cables to the press.
veio.guide.page.08:
4. Your first plate

The press takes RAW COPPER in the left slot. The plate appears on the right.

Try inserting raw copper by hand.

Take a plate from the panel or chest.
veio.guide.page.09:
5. Make gears

Craft an assembler. Connect power and feed it copper plates.

Each gear uses TWO copper plates.

Put a chest at the output and take your first gear.
veio.guide.page.10:
6. Next steps

Craft the wrench to turn blocks with right-click.

Build an iron line: press > cutter > frame.

The integrator turns a frame and gear into a module.
veio.guide.page.11:
When a machine stops

No power: check fuel and cables.

No ore: check the block underneath.

Missing material: inspect the slots.

Output full: make room downstream.
veio.guide.page.12:
Controls and help

Empty hand + right-click opens the panel.

Wrench + right-click turns it.

Hover over ? or an empty slot for help.

Powered redstone pauses production.
veio.guide.page.13:
Your checklist

Open Advancements and find First Factory. Milestones track obtained materials.

Pick up products to mark progress.

Inspect machine panels to confirm operation.

veio.guide.page.14:
Poles and wires

Each pole powers machines within 2 blocks (steel: 3) and links to nearby poles.

Wood: 8-block wires, 120 FE/t.
Steel: 16 blocks, 400 FE/t.

If far machines starve, the wire is the bottleneck.
veio.guide.page.15:
Pollution

Working machines pollute their chunk; the panel shows how much per minute. It spreads and slowly fades.

Harvested crops absorb it. Efficiency modules halve it.

veio.guide.page.16:
Raiders

Chat warns a day ahead. The next night they come with a raid horn: for you and for the villagers.

Face them. Four hits stop a machine or kill a villager, and that post sits idle. Walls, a sword and Tesla towers.
veio.guide.page.17:
Modules

Right-click a machine to install one. Sneak with the wrench to remove it.

Speed: more output, power and pollution.
Efficiency: less power and pollution.
Productivity: +10% products.
veio.guide.page.18:
Factory and world

Harvester: build the farm around it and belt the crops away.

Tesla tower: guards the base at night. Pair solar with batteries.

Monster bones become bone meal in the crusher.
veio.guide.page.19:
Trade

After the four projects, the hub keeps exporting: 4 circuits and 4 steel plates become 4 emeralds and experience bottles.

Spend emeralds with your villagers.

veio.guide.page.20:
Production ladder

Each upgrade fixes one bottleneck and reveals the next: vein, power, wire, pollution.

Big veins pay off: the extractor reads the 3x3 below. A pure vein doubles its speed.
veio.guide.page.21:
Power

Water wheel and wind: free and clean; 8 FE/t per face or at sea level.
Generator and biomass: 40 FE/t; biomass pollutes less.
Steam: 120 FE/t, needs water.
Geothermal and solar: scale up.

Batteries carry the night.
veio.guide.page.22:
Food and village

Wheat > mill > flour > kitchen > bread.
Ranch meat > electric furnace.

The pantry pays emeralds for food, more for cooked food, and 50% more with villagers near.

veio.village.page.02:
The worker village

You start at the center of a village. Villagers start working for you, and the village grows with the factory.

Follow the steps in order. The Worker Village advancement tab tracks progress.
veio.village.page.03:
1. First worker

Place a farmhand post near crops and villagers.

Put bread in the left slot and click the post with an emerald.

The villager harvests and brings the crop back.
veio.village.page.04:
2. Mark the field

Place the field marker at the center of the field, with water nearby.

Posts within 3 blocks of the border work the whole area: till, plant and harvest.

Seed in the marker: only that is planted.
veio.village.page.05:
3. Pens

Fence the animals and put the pen marker in the middle. A nearby shepherd post tends them.

Feed in the marker sets the pen: carrots for pigs, seeds for chickens, wheat for cows and sheep.
veio.village.page.06:
4. Barn and silo

The barn keeps any item; the silo, grain and food.

Hoppers insert and extract. With a foreman nearby, surplus goes there by itself.
veio.village.page.07:
5. Haulers

The hauler post feeds machines within 6 blocks from the left slots and brings products to the right.

It leaves belts alone.
veio.village.page.08:
6. Foreman and queue

The foreman desk manages 6 posts within 12 blocks: brings food and rehires with emeralds.

It queues deliveries between posts, machines and storage, done by haulers.
veio.village.page.09:
7. Control center

Hire an administrator. The panel shows workers, waits, zones, storage and goals.

Item in a goal slot: x16 stored. Book on the center: report. Spawn moves to the center.
veio.village.page.10:
Grow the zones

Emerald on the marker unlocks the next level:
13x13: 8 emer., 32 tasks, 6 villagers
17x17: 16, 128, 12
21x21: 32, 384, 20

The wrench picks the size among unlocked ones.
veio.village.page.11:
The village grows

Cap: 30 villagers, +3 per staffed post, +5 per zone level, +2 per storage, +20 for the control center. Max 150.

Each one needs a bed: with no free bed, nobody is born.
veio.village.page.12:
Play on your network

Host: Esc, Open to LAN, Start LAN World. The world stays on your computer.

Join: the same Wi-Fi, Multiplayer, the world shows in the list. Install the same Veio version.

Each player uses their own account. The machines are the host's.
veio.village.page.13:
When a villager stops

No food: add bread.
Missing: bring them back or dismiss (sneak + wrench).
Path blocked: clear the way.
Output full: empty it or use a barn.
Hover over the panel status for tips.

veio.village.page.14:
Barracks

Four iron ingots, one emerald and smooth stone. The recipe unlocks with circuits.

An emerald hires. Sneak with an empty hand cycles the class, and each change spends an emerald from the slot.

Militia: three blows.
Guard: tank, monsters come for them.
Archer: shoots from far away.
Mage: two blows and wounds another.

Each blow eats one task. With no food the soldier stays at the post. One barracks, one soldier.
veio.village.page.15:
Food

Each task costs 2 points. Wheat is worth 1, potato and carrot 1, bread 6 (3 tasks), cooked meat 8 (4 tasks), pie 10.

Cooked food goes further: build a mill and kitchen early.
